symptom: agent skimmed a long skill and shipped errors
cause: key rules and QA pitfalls are stated once, deep in the text
rule: run extract_rules.py on any provided skill/spec and convert every MUST/NEVER line into a task-card criterion before building

symptom: output looked nothing like the reference result
cause: built from a blank page instead of the shipped example
rule: run the provided example unchanged first, then copy its structure and change only the content

symptom: video had visible errors the agent did not notice
cause: agent said 'looks good' without actually viewing frames (or cannot see images)
rule: view real frames at phone size every 0.5-1 s; if you cannot see images, say so and use measurable checks and ask the user to review

symptom: function or option does not exist at runtime
cause: name recalled from memory or similar library, not verified
rule: before using any API/flag, grep the source or run --help to confirm it exists and check its signature

symptom: repeated failing fixes with no progress
cause: changed several things at once and repeated the same move
rule: one hypothesis, one change, re-run; after two failures change approach and re-read instructions

symptom: task reported done but deliverable was broken
cause: claimed success from reasoning, not from running or opening the output
rule: never say done without evidence; open the real output and pass the task-card gate first

symptom: selftest passed but result was poor
cause: selftest only proves the pipeline runs, not that quality is good
rule: treat pipeline checks as necessary only; add quality checks (frames, audio level, timing, text fit) and a hostile review

symptom: skill step failed silently in another agent
cause: skill assumed tools from a different agent (e.g. specific APIs)
rule: map each tool the skill names to an available equivalent, or state what is missing; never skip a step silently

cause: no persisted state, context grew long
rule: keep a task card and notes file; checkpoint after each verified step and resume from them

symptom: agent took an action the user had not approved
rule: ask before publishing, spending, deleting or overwriting whenever the task or skill says to confirm

cause: single source, no date check, inference presented as fact
rule: use two independent sources, note dates, label facts vs inferences, and state confidence

cause: wrote short fragments instead of how a person talks
rule: write connected spoken sentences, then read aloud mentally; rewrite anything that sounds like a list
